scope: read-only source investigation; only this new evidence JSON is written; no tests or broker connections
search_methods: AST walk every non-tests v6lite/**/*.py Call(Attribute.audit), preserving each source span and enclosing function/if context; expand IfExp and audit_kind assignment explicitly
Follow state consumers through Store.protection/intent, protection evidence, TP evidence, overnight a-d, recovery/release, clear-anomaly and reporting

target_kind_consumers.detail: daily_report audit_for_day includes ORDER_PRICE_OBSERVATION at233; detail is presentation only

SELECT MAX(ts) FROM audit indirectly includes both kinds for fallback clock when Store lacks Engine.report_clock; dedup can move this max backwards. Preserve future replay cutoff semantics via process observation clock / durable protections updated_at or confirmed_at and summary timestamps. Do not claim zero indirect dependency.
connection snapshots must not add ORDER rows; matching assertion at68

safety_state_readers.detail: 15-second steady scheduling; SQL UPDATE, confirmed_at and updated_at must be identical
BE action binding depends on row confirmed_at
health confirmation presentation reads state row
A gaps use protection_gap_a durable table and protections gap start, not target audit kinds
B close reads protections row; writes PROTECT_GAP, retained
recovery reads active intents, fills, broker fresh evidence
TP proof reads in-memory fresh proof, row and controls
overnight a-d reads ledger/markers/current fresh proof; no target-kind latest-record authority
release requires fresh open_orders, executions and positions
clear-anomaly consumes controls, not target audit history

connection_shutdown_notes.detail: _reset_channels increments actual query_generation. ConnectionEvent loss/restoration can occur on same socket; do not treat as a new generation by itself.
_on_connection toggles flags/refresh, not a reliable generation change source.

normal shutdown cancels DAY, retains GTC, waits/drains, then SHUTDOWN at3072. Flush observations after order safety work and before SHUTDOWN/report; dry branch at3010 also flush. Never introduce broker query or change state rows.
